title: How a Man of God Handles a Breakup Without Losing His Faith
caption:
A breakup doesn't just end a relationship. It shows you where your hope was actually sitting.

If she was the thing holding you up, it's going to feel like the floor went with her. That's not a sign God left. It's a sign He's closer than the pain lets you feel right now.

Grieve it honestly. Mute the page. Don't run to the next one. Call two brothers.

Send this to the guy who's been quiet since it ended.

#faith #godlyman #breakup #brotherhood
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
